_doc: Revert-verify mutants for the `query --stats` pruning line in query-prune-report.ts (RFC 308a52c3 Д4, phase 4, vault-exodev task c7a94d8e): the stats record reuses pruneReport (loader units), the mode label, k of a full load (every predicate of the graph), the reasons as the report prints them, the «recorded» mark of a cache hit, the check of a recorded line (a string · starts with the prefix · no control character). Each mutant reddens exactly `expect` (mutant-driver, control 0; M11–M12 — found by the specification review, M13–M14 — by its closing round). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders (§A145).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/commands/query-prune-report.ts

M1_namespace_label_lost._note: a namespace-filter prune is labelled «prune»: the VL-3 axis and the equality with --prune-report on the namespace form.

M2_full_k_is_p_prime._note: a full load reports «all 0 predicate(s)» (P' is empty for a full load). S4 normalizes a full load's k (not a --prune-report field) and stays green — that separates M2 from M5.

M3_reasons_kind_only._note: the reason loses its variable («variable-predicate» instead of «variable-predicate (?p)»); «update» has no variable, so S11 stays green.

M4_cut_is_loaded._note: N = M for a prune; S5a/S5b compare the hit with ITS fresh line (both wrong alike), and on the empty graph (S18) N = M = 0 anyway — the exact numbers are pinned by S1, S2, S4, S10a, S10b, S13.

M6_recorded_suffix_dropped._note: a hit prints the recorded line as if it were fresh: S5b and S10b pin the mark; S5a (the recorded line, not «not recorded») stays green — that separates M6 from M10.

M7_check_skips_the_type._note: a value that is not a string reaches startsWith and throws: the line becomes «not computed» instead of «not recorded» — nothing recorded (S6, the hit half of S9) and a recorded object (S12a).

M8_check_skips_the_prefix._note: any string without a control character is printed as the recorded line.

M9_check_skips_control_characters._note: a recorded line with a line break or a terminal control sequence is printed: it breaks the statistics block or the terminal. S12f–S12i (bug 685d5ffe) redden too: the whole control-character check is gone.

M10_check_rejects_valid._note: every recorded line is refused: a hit after a --stats run says «not recorded». Same set as the wiring's W7 and the cache's C2 — links of one chain (stored → handed out → checked).

M11_one_reason_of_several._note: a full load with several reasons names only the first (found by the independent review of the specification).

M12_share_recomputed._note: the share is recomputed instead of taken from pruneReport: NaN on an empty graph (found by the independent review).

M13_prefix_anywhere._note: the prefix is accepted anywhere in the string, not at its start (found by the closing review round).

M14_line_breaks_only._note: the check narrowed to line breaks lets a terminal control sequence through (found by the closing review round). S12f–S12i (bug 685d5ffe) redden too: NEL and U+2028 are not \r/\n.

M15_check_c0_only._note: Bug 685d5ffe (review of PR #4625, LOW-1): C0 only — C1 and the Unicode line separators pass.

M18_check_nel_and_ls_only._note: Bug 685d5ffe, closing review (P1): only NEL and LS instead of all C1 and both separators — CSI and PS pass.
